summary: Riders mostly love the CAPiTA Mercury 2025 for its edge hold and stability at speed, calling it a great all-rounder. It is stiff and comes alive only when moving fast, so several found it sluggish or less fun at slow speeds and in the park.

Riders mostly love the CAPiTA Mercury 2024, praising how stable and capable it is at speed and in everyday riding. A couple noticed a catchy twitch at slow speeds, which one said faded after a few days.

Riders describe the CAPiTA The Black Snowboard of Death 2025 as fast and fun, carving well and suiting freeriding. Opinions on the flex differ, from firm but friendly to stiff, especially torsionally.
Most riders like the Jones Mountain Twin 2025, on groomers and in powder. One finds it a bit stiff and heavy for learning park tricks.
Riders love the CAPiTA Indoor Survival 2023 as a playful board that is easy to butter yet stable at speed. Though sold as a park board, several ride it happily all over the mountain.
